description.narrative: Alumni UK is one of the Global Programmes through which the British Council delivers its grant-funded activity. The primary focus of this Global Programme is ODA eligible activity and outcomes. The Alumni UK creates a global network for international students who have studied at a UK Higher Education institution. The programme supports alumni to extend their connection with the UK and each other once they have finished their studies, giving them the opportunity to join a global online community. The programme attracts and supports a growing number of international student alumni from the UK. It provides opportunities for alumni to connect with others in their home countries and across borders to network, collaborate, and engage on global development challenges. The programme includes career development opportunities, learning and professional growth activities, and ways to stay connected to the UK. Most activities are delivered digitally, allowing the programme to reach large numbers of alumni worldwide. This is complemented by some in-country face-to-face events in key priority countries.

The audience for the programme is:◼ International UK alumni who studied at a Higher Education Institution in the UK.◼ International alumni who studied at a UK transnational education programme overseas.

The main goal is to build and grow a global, dynamic and impactful network of alumni who, by connecting with each other and the UK, can become more effective as agents for change in their respective fields. The programme aims to support alumni with their professional competence, increase their knowledge, grow their networks and demonstrate increased levels of effectiveness in their work that leads to positive development impacts. We also work with international alumni to position the UK as an attractive study destination through alumni testimonials. In addition, we work towards a growing recognition by the UK government and other institutions of the significant value offered by the UK’s global alumni network. The change we make:◼ Alumni are able to develop their skills and have career progression opportunities.◼ Higher Education sector partners, government institutions, universities and other key stakeholders have increased access to insights about international UK Alumni.◼ Alumni supported to contribute positively to global challenges.◼ Alumni as positive champions of UK higher education.◼ International UK alumni are celebrated, and their achievements are showcased on global platforms.
